title: How much does an apartment cost in Rova 4?
note: PriceGuide data for /north-tel-aviv/rova-4/ in AREA mode (no tower floor model). Same shape as scripts/project-stage/price_guide/hamedina.json. Every row's src points to ids in docs/content/rova-4-2026-10/facts.md. The page shows dates only, no source names. Asking prices are labelled as asking and never averaged with deals. RENDERER NOTE: render.py default_result() and the JS assume modes[0] is a floor mode (lo_floor1/hi_floor39/band); an area branch is needed before this file can render (use modes[i].lo/hi only, hide the floor slider, no deals_plot).

answer: In the first quarter of 2026, the median deal for an apartment with 4 rooms in Rova 4 ranged from ₪6,042,800 to ₪6,910,000, depending on the neighbourhood, against ₪5,229,800 across Tel Aviv-Yafo. For 3 rooms, the median ranged from ₪4,434,900 to ₪4,943,500. In the new buildings around Kikar HaMedina, prices stand at ₪63,000 to ₪68,000 per m², down from ₪70,000 to ₪75,000 at the peak, and penthouses and garden apartments reach ₪80,000 to ₪110,000 per m².

src_line: This price guide draws on median deals reported to the Tax Authority, on published deals, on estimates by property professionals in the area and on listings for sale. Asking prices are marked separately and are not closing prices. Updated 7 October 2026.
